README.txt.author: System
README.txt.content:
LEVEL 4: THE LOC PROPHECIES

Every batch leaves behind strange messages near the LOC. Some are motivational, some are hilarious, and some are cryptic prophecies about the future of the campus. Explore the archives and the physical LOC area to discover the legacy of those who came before you.

Objective: Discover the full form of LOC.
Answer passcode clue: Submit the answer you get as 'submit <answer>' to unlock the next level.
Useful Commands:
- ls
- ls -a
- cd
- cat
- grep
.

Bench 1 Inscription.txt.author: Batch 2016
Bench 1 Inscription.txt.content: To the ones who follow: The placements will come, the grades will fade, but the sunsets at LOC are forever.

Bench 2 Nostalgia.txt.author: Batch 2017
Bench 2 Nostalgia.txt.content: We sat here discussing start-ups that never started and classes we never attended. Treasure these quiet moments. It is not just a degree, it is the smell of wet soil and late-night laughter.

Bench 3 Poem.txt.author: Campus Poet
Bench 3 Poem.txt.content:
Reflections on the ripples,
Under the Ropar sky,
We came with nervous questions,
And left with a tear in our eye.
The winds of Chenab still whisper,
The dust of Nalanda still calls,
But the heart of this college lingers,
Within these walls.

Sunset Spot Log.txt.author: Photography Club
Sunset Spot Log.txt.content:
Best camera settings for LOC sunset:
- Aperture: f/8
- ISO: 100
- Exposure: 1/125s
Note: At around 06:45 PM, the sky turns into a perfect blend of orange and purple. Keep an eye out for the ducks flying across the horizon.

Warden Inspection Notes.txt.author: Hostel Warden
Warden Inspection Notes.txt.content: Surveillance check: 22:30 PM. Found three students singing acoustic songs near Bench 3. Advised them to return to their hostels due to oncoming winter fog. No disciplinary action taken as they were exceptionally polite.

Maintenance Bench Report.txt.author: Estate Office
Maintenance Bench Report.txt.content: Wooden benches 1 through 5 near the northern curve have been polished and treated for moisture protection. Added a commemorative plaque on Bench 1 representing the founding batches of the permanent campus.

Lost Water Bottle.txt.author: Security Guard
Lost Water Bottle.txt.content: A metallic water bottle with a sticker that says 'CODE ALL NIGHT' was found on Bench 4. Kept in the estate office locker.

Batch of 2016 Message.txt.author: Batch Rep 2016
Batch of 2016 Message.txt.content: We were the pioneers who transitioned from the transit campus. There were no roads, only blueprints. But we carried the hope of a thousand dreams. Take care of our campus, juniors!

Batch of 2017 Regrets.txt.author: Anonymous 2017
Batch of 2017 Regrets.txt.content: I regret not talking to my crush in the library. I regret failing my first math quiz. But sitting here on graduation day, watching the clouds mirror themselves, all those worries seem so small.

Batch of 2018 Hopes.txt.author: Batch Prez 2018
Batch of 2018 Hopes.txt.content: We hope that when you open this, the campus trees have grown tall, the laboratories are world-class, and the canteen still serves the same spicy samosas we loved. Let your imagination run wild in this sanctuary.

Batch of 2019 Triumph.txt.author: Sports Sec 2019
Batch of 2019 Triumph.txt.content: We celebrated by coming to the LOC at 4:00 AM and jumping into the cold air after winning sports competitions. The victory belongs to the soil of Ropar. We also are the ones to name the LOC as 'LANDMARK OF CAMPUS'.

Batch of 2020 Pandemic Logs.txt.author: Corona Survivor
Batch of 2020 Pandemic Logs.txt.content: Our final semester was cut short. We attended classes on Microsoft Teams and Zoom. We missed the chats, and the corridors. To anyone reading this in a normal world: do not take a single physical day for granted!

Batch of 2021 Crypto Craze.txt.author: Tech Enthusiast
Batch of 2021 Crypto Craze.txt.content: Half the hostel is mining cryptocurrency on lab PCs. The other half is arguing about NFTs. We hid a paper wallet somewhere on campus, but we forgot the private key. Oh well, the real treasure is the friendships!

Batch of 2022 New Hostels.txt.author: Hostelite 2022
Batch of 2022 New Hostels.txt.content: Moved into the brand new hostel blocks. The view of the mountains on clear days is breathtaking. Ropar's winter is magical. Make sure to buy warm clothes and possibly a heat but hide it from warden!

Batch of 2023 ChatGPT Era.txt.author: CS Student
Batch of 2023 ChatGPT Era.txt.content: ChatGPT is writing our assignments. The professors are getting smart, asking us to explain our code in viva sessions. The game of cat and mouse continues. But the AI can't write the feelings we share.

Batch of 2024 Prophecy.txt.author: Batch Rep
Batch of 2024 Prophecy.txt.content: We leave behind a campus that's still growing, just like us. Our prophecy: The next batch will find a way to make the WiFi actually work in the hostels.

Batch of 2025 Legacy.txt.author: Valedictorian
Batch of 2025 Legacy.txt.content:
To the future historians: We survived the hardest exams, celebrated the biggest fests, and sat at the same benches you sit on. This campus learns from its past. The meaning of LOC has changed from LANDMARK to L- ohh anyways...

To go to next stage use the secret: LOVEOFCAMPUS

confessions.txt.author: Secret Confessor
confessions.txt.content: I skipped class to watch CWC 2023. No regrets.

photograph desc 1.txt.author: Curator
photograph desc 1.txt.content: Image ID: IMG 3401. A group of students in black graduation gowns tossing their caps into the air with the LOC in the background. The expressions are a mix of relief and nostalgia.

photograph desc 2.txt.author: Curator
photograph desc 2.txt.content: Image ID: IMG 5002. Late night at the library. A student is asleep on a pile of books, while their friend is smiling and showing a thumbs-up to the camera. Caption: 'The night before the GE103 exam'.

photograph desc 3.txt.author: Curator
photograph desc 3.txt.content: Image ID: IMG 1109. Unofficial music jam near the mess. There is a guitar, a djembe, and several cell phone flashlights lighting up the night.

Ecology Report 2024.txt.author: Eco Audit
Ecology Report 2024.txt.content: The ecosystem is in healthy equilibrium. The introduction of local flora has stabilized the soil around the banks. Water level is maintained through sustainable rainwater harvesting systems.

Migratory Birds Log.txt.author: Bird Watcher
Migratory Birds Log.txt.content:
Sighting records this winter:
- Bar-headed Geese: 14 spotted near the western marsh.
- Ruddy Shelducks: 8 spotted swimming in pairs.
- Northern Pintails: 5 spotted resting near the reeds.
Students are requested to keep noise levels down near the boundaries.

Flora and Fauna Survey.txt.author: Biology Dept
Flora and Fauna Survey.txt.content:
Recorded species around the LOC:
1. Typha latifolia (broadleaf cattail) - providing nesting habitat for birds.
2. Nelumbo nucifera (sacred lotus) - partially covering the north-east inlet.
3. Indian Spot-billed Duck - resident species breeding in the grasses.

Water Quality Analysis.txt.content:
Water analysis metrics:
- pH level: 7.4 (Normal)
- Dissolved Oxygen: 6.8 mg/L (Excellent for aquatic life)
- Turbidity: Low

Depth Measurement.txt.author: Hydrology Lab
Depth Measurement.txt.content: Average depth: 3.5 meters. Deepest point: 5.2 meters near the central fountain node. Bathymetry scan completed successfully.

Marathon Trail Map.txt.author: Athletics Coach
Marathon Trail Map.txt.content: Annual Campus Run Route: Start at Sports Complex -> pass Brahmaputra Hostel -> follow the (1 full loop of LOC) -> finish at Academic Block corridor. Total distance: 5.2 Kilometers.

Morning Joggers Registry.txt.content:

Air remains the freshest section of the campus.

Athletic Club Announcement.txt.author: Club Captain
Athletic Club Announcement.txt.content: Triathlon training sessions start this Friday. Bring running shoes and bicycles. Swimming is strictly forbidden, so we will use the college pool instead. Oh it doesn't exist so we'll go to Shivalik

physics lab survival.txt.author: Lab Survivor
physics lab survival.txt.content: If you can survive the first-year Physics lab, you can survive anything.

midsem rage.txt.author: Stressed Out
midsem rage.txt.content: Why does the professor think we are machines? Five assignments in one week! I came to the LOC to scream. It helped. 10/10 would recommend.

relationship confessions.txt.author: Romeo
relationship confessions.txt.content: I carved our initials on the bark of the eucalyptus tree. She smiled. Ropar campus is romantic in the winter mist.

the maggie plea.txt.author: Hungry Soul
the maggie plea.txt.content: Bring back 2:00 AM food deliveries! Studying for electromagnetism on an empty stomach is cruel.

secret crush initials.txt.author: Secret Admirer
secret crush initials.txt.content: XXXX from CSE: you are the highlight of my morning lectures. I wish I had the courage to ask you for coffee at DUC.

the wifi lament.txt.author: Disconnected
the wifi lament.txt.content: WiFi went down during my online contest. I got blacklisted? No, the router was just tired. Now I am studying offline like the ancient scholars.

dorm room hacks.txt.author: Hostel MacGyver
dorm room hacks.txt.content: How to make espresso using a hair dryer and a coffee mug: [REDACTED FOR FIRE SAFETY]. Seriously, just buy an electric kettle guys.

class of 2024.txt.author: Batch Rep
class of 2024.txt.content: We leave behind a campus that's still growing, just like us. Our prophecy: The next batch will find a way to make the WiFi actually work in the hostels.

hostel life memories.txt.author: Hostel Warden
hostel life memories.txt.content: Found a box of old photos from the 2010s. The hairstyles have changed, but the look of 'exam-stress' on their faces is exactly the same.

Weird Notice.txt.author: Dean Office
Weird Notice.txt.content: Students are reminded that the LOC is an eco-zone. Please keep it clean like your search history.

Valedictorian Speech Draft.txt.author: Valedictorian 2024
Valedictorian Speech Draft.txt.content: Respected Director, Faculty, and my fellow peers. Today we step out of this sanctuary into a competitive world. Let us remember the lessons of resilience we learned here. Let us remember the late nights, the peer support, and the tranquil sunsets at the LOC. We are Roparians!

SUMMARY REPORTS.txt.content: You have read the prophecies and memories of the past. You realize that every student at IIT Ropar is part of a larger story. Your journey is just one chapter in the campus history.
